content: cargo-insta (Rust) separates 'run tests, capture new snapshots as .snap.new' from 'cargo insta review', an interactive TUI diff review with a/r/q (accept/reject/quit) and bulk A/R/S. Accepting renames .snap.new to .snap (the committed baseline). Deliberately splits detection from acceptance so multiple changes can be triaged in one session and regressions rejected individually while approved diffs are batch-accepted.
